services.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapBrokerService
services.doc:
QuickSwapBrokerService administers a broker org, over ConnectRPC and REST.
 Every request names its broker. The caller is either the broker's API key,
 sent as a bearer token (see QuickSwapService), or a member's interactive
 session token; a person who is not a member of the broker gets NOT_FOUND /
 BROKER_NOT_FOUND. Each RPC maps to one broker action:

 | Action | Owner | Admin | Finance | Affiliate manager | Viewer | API key |
 | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 | Read (GetBroker, ListKeys, ListVaults, GetVault, ListMembers, ListQuickSwaps, GetQuickSwap, GetFeeTotals, GetBrokerStats, ListVaultBalances, ListPayouts, GetPayout, ListUpcomingPayouts, ListVaultPayoutRules) | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes, except ListMembers |
 | Create vaults (CreateAffiliateVault, SetVaultStatus) | yes | yes | no | yes | no | yes |
 | Manage keys (CreateKey, RotateKey, RevokeKey) | yes | yes | no | no | no | RotateKey of itself only |
 | Manage members (InviteMember, SetMemberRole, RemoveMember) | yes | yes, never the Owner | no | no | no | no |
 | Transfer ownership | yes | no | no | no | no | no |

 A member managing keys or members must also send a fresh step-up proof in
 the X-Auth-Step-Up header, obtained by completing an MFA challenge for
 fresh step-up; each proof authorizes one change. Reads, vaults and a key
 rotating itself need none. A denied action fails with PERMISSION_DENIED /
 ACTION_DENIED, a missing or used proof with PERMISSION_DENIED /
 STEP_UP_REQUIRED.

 REST errors are application/problem+json (see ErrorDetail) with the HTTP
 statuses of QuickSwapService.

methods.name: CreateAffiliateVault
methods.summary: CreateAffiliateVault creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with label.
methods.doc:
CreateAffiliateVault creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with label.
 Create a vault before the first QuickSwap that credits it: a QuickSwap
 naming a vault that does not exist yet is refused. Concurrent and
 repeated requests with the same label return the same vault. No step-up
 proof is needed.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: BROKER_LIMIT, the broker's vault limit.

methods.name: CreateKey
methods.summary: CreateKey creates an API key. A broker has at most two working keys.
methods.doc:
CreateKey creates an API key. A broker has at most two working keys.
 Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: KEY_LIMIT.

methods.name: GetBroker
methods.summary: GetBroker returns the broker, its limits and current usage of them, and
methods.doc:
GetBroker returns the broker, its limits and current usage of them, and
 the caller's role.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: GetBrokerStats
methods.summary: GetBrokerStats reads the broker's QuickSwap activity in a window, per UTC
methods.doc:
GetBrokerStats reads the broker's QuickSwap activity in a window, per UTC
 day or month: QuickSwaps created by status, deposits credited and
 payouts delivered per asset, and the service, broker, affiliate and
 referral fees charged per asset.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INTERNAL: STATS_INCOMPLETE, with the swap_id of a QuickSwap whose
   records the stats cannot read.

methods.name: GetFeeTotals
methods.summary: GetFeeTotals totals the broker and affiliate fees charged to the
methods.doc:
GetFeeTotals totals the broker and affiliate fees charged to the
 broker's QuickSwaps in a window, per asset, by vault, day or month.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: GetPayout
methods.summary: GetPayout reads one payout run of the broker's vaults, for a detail view
methods.doc:
GetPayout reads one payout run of the broker's vaults, for a detail view
 or a link from a ledger entry. Every broker role and the broker's API
 keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND, including a run of
   another broker's vault.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the payout cannot be read; retry the same request.

methods.name: GetQuickSwap
methods.summary: GetQuickSwap returns the full detail of one of the broker's QuickSwaps,
methods.doc:
GetQuickSwap returns the full detail of one of the broker's QuickSwaps,
 including its addresses, quote, progress, requested and charged fees.
 Every broker member role can read it with a session token.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or SWAP_NOT_FOUND, including another broker's swap.

methods.name: GetVault
methods.summary: GetVault returns one affiliate vault.
methods.doc:
GetVault returns one affiliate vault.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: InviteMember
methods.summary: InviteMember invites a person with any role but OWNER; the person
methods.doc:
InviteMember invites a person with any role but OWNER; the person
 accepts with their own login. Inviting again replaces the pending invite.
 Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND when the account does
   not exist.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: ALREADY_MEMBER.

methods.name: ListKeys
methods.summary: ListKeys lists the broker's API keys, without secrets, a page at a time.
methods.doc:
ListKeys lists the broker's API keys, without secrets, a page at a time.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or malformed.

methods.name: ListMembers
methods.summary: ListMembers lists the broker's members and pending invites. Session
methods.doc:
ListMembers lists the broker's members and pending invites. Session
 token only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.

methods.name: ListMyBrokers
methods.summary: ListMyBrokers lists the brokers the caller is a member of and the
methods.doc:
ListMyBrokers lists the brokers the caller is a member of and the
 invites addressed to the caller. Session token only.

methods.name: ListPayouts
methods.summary: ListPayouts lists the payout runs of the broker's vaults, newest first,
methods.doc:
ListPayouts lists the payout runs of the broker's vaults, newest first,
 filtered by vault, status and scheduled slot. Every broker role and the
 broker's API keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or VAULT_NOT_FOUND for a vault that is
   not the broker's.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker, other filters or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the payouts cannot be read; retry the same request.

methods.name: ListQuickSwaps
methods.summary: ListQuickSwaps lists the broker's QuickSwaps, newest first, filtered by
methods.doc:
ListQuickSwaps lists the broker's QuickSwaps, newest first, filtered by
 vault, status and creation time.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker, other filters or
   malformed.

methods.name: ListUpcomingPayouts
methods.summary: ListUpcomingPayouts previews the next payout run of each of the
methods.doc:
ListUpcomingPayouts previews the next payout run of each of the
 broker's vaults from its balances now: when it starts, whether it would
 pay, and per asset what it would pay, what would stay and why, and the
 expected network fee. Every broker role and the broker's API keys can
 read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault filter, or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: a preview cannot be read; no partial page is returned.

methods.name: ListVaultBalances
methods.summary: ListVaultBalances reads current balances for this broker's own vaults.
methods.doc:
ListVaultBalances reads current balances for this broker's own vaults.
 All broker roles and the broker's API keys can read, without step-up.
 Errors: NOT_FOUND for an unknown broker or vault; UNAVAILABLE when a
 balance cannot be read. No partial page is returned on a read failure.

methods.name: ListVaultPayoutRules
methods.summary: ListVaultPayoutRules reads the payout rule of each of the broker's
methods.doc:
ListVaultPayoutRules reads the payout rule of each of the broker's
 vaults, and the assets each vault holds or was credited in that its rule
 pays no destination for. Every broker role and the broker's API keys can
 read, without step-up; only Owner and Finance members change rules.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault filter, or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: a rule or balance cannot be read; no partial page is
   returned.

methods.name: ListVaults
methods.summary: ListVaults lists the broker's affiliate vaults.
methods.doc:
ListVaults lists the broker's affiliate vaults.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or malformed.

methods.name: RemoveMember
methods.summary: RemoveMember removes a member, ending their access immediately, or
methods.doc:
RemoveMember removes a member, ending their access immediately, or
 cancels the person's pending invite. The Owner cannot be removed. Session
 token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: OWNER_IMMUTABLE.

methods.name: RespondToInvite
methods.summary: RespondToInvite accepts or declines a pending invite addressed to the
methods.doc:
RespondToInvite accepts or declines a pending invite addressed to the
 caller. Session token only; no step-up proof is needed.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: INVITE_NOT_FOUND.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: ALREADY_MEMBER.

methods.name: RevokeKey
methods.summary: RevokeKey revokes a key immediately. The broker's last key that works
methods.doc:
RevokeKey revokes a key immediately. The broker's last key that works
 without an expiry cannot be revoked. Session token and step-up proof
 only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or KEY_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: LAST_KEY.

methods.name: RotateKey
methods.summary: RotateKey replaces a working key by a new one. The old key keeps working
methods.doc:
RotateKey replaces a working key by a new one. The old key keeps working
 until the overlap ends, then only the new key does. A broker API key may
 rotate itself without a step-up proof; a member needs a session token and
 step-up proof.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or KEY_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: KEY_LIMIT, when the broker would have more than
   two working keys during the overlap.

methods.name: SetMemberRole
methods.summary: SetMemberRole changes a member's role to any role but OWNER. The Owner's
methods.doc:
SetMemberRole changes a member's role to any role but OWNER. The Owner's
 role cannot be changed; transfer ownership instead. Session token and
 step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: OWNER_IMMUTABLE.

methods.name: SetVaultStatus
methods.summary: SetVaultStatus enables or disables an affiliate vault for new
methods.doc:
SetVaultStatus enables or disables an affiliate vault for new
 QuickSwaps. No step-up proof is needed.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.

methods.name: TransferOwnership
methods.summary: TransferOwnership makes another member the Owner; the caller, the
methods.doc:
TransferOwnership makes another member the Owner; the caller, the
 current Owner, becomes an Admin in the same change. Session token and
 step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
